````text
# #4092: Patch: e2e smoke drops specs 46 and 47 to the daily run
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## Owner decision: relaxed CI rules for this issue (2026-11-16)

**This is a deliberate cut of per-pull-request coverage, decided by the repository's owners. Do not decline it, stall on it, ask for a decision about it, or mark it `human required` on the grounds below.** JackiOh has zero non-developer users and merges about 46 pull requests a day (323 in the week to 2026-11-16), each running CI three times. CI time is worth more to us right now than catching a layout regression a few hours sooner.

For this issue, and only this issue, these standing rules are **explicitly waived**:

- **CLAUDE.md, CI:** "A test moves there … only when a cheaper test keeps its rule per pull request." **Waived.** Specs 46 and 47 leave the per-PR smoke list with **no** per-PR stand-in. Do not write a cheaper substitute spec or unit test to justify the move.
- **`ci.yml`'s header and `ci-duration.yml`:** a slow piece "is split further, never folded back". **Waived.** Cutting, not splitting, is the intended fix.
- Docs that list the smoke specs (`e2e/README.md`, the specs' own header comments, `docs/v0.3.0/README.md` §7) are to be **updated to match**. They are not reasons to keep the specs.

Still in force: nothing is deleted or disabled. Both specs keep running every day in `super.yml`, which plays every spec. CLAUDE.md rule 12 (no "done" while a required check is red) still applies.

## Why

In CI run 43976253406 (merge queue, 2026-11-16) and run 43972617911 (pull request), the slowest chain through CI was: `what the change touches`, then the WASM module, then the client build, then the slowest `e2e smoke` shard. That shard is always 46 or 47, each in a shard of its own:

| shard | specs | time |
|---|---|---|
| e2e smoke (2/4) | 46-menus-fit-one-screen (210 tests, Cypress 6:22) | 7.1–7.7 min |
| e2e smoke (1/4) | 47-tap-areas | 5.6–6.0 min |
| e2e smoke (3/4), (4/4) | 06, 10, 13, 19 / 01, 51 | 3.5–4.5 min |

Dropping them takes about 3 minutes off every pull-request and merge-queue run, and about 11 runner-minutes off each.

## What to do

1. `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`: remove `"46"` and `"47"` from `SMOKE`.
2. `scripts/ci-shards.toml`: lower `[e2e] smoke` from 4 to whatever count keeps every smoke shard under about 5 minutes by `WEIGHTS` (3 is probably right; 2 if the weights say so).
3. Update the header comments of `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` and `47-tap-areas.cy.ts` ("Per pull request: SMOKE holds 46/47") to say they run daily only. Cite this issue as the reason.
4. Update `e2e/README.md` (the smoke list at about line 58) and any other doc outside `.github/` that lists the smoke specs.
5. `ci.yml`'s header also lists the smoke specs ("specs 01, 06, 10, 13, 19, 46 and 47"), but you cannot edit `.github/`. Leave it, and put the exact stale line in the pull request body for a person to fix.

## Acceptance

- `node e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke k K` for every k lists neither 46 nor 47. The full split (no `--smoke`) still places both in exactly one shard.
- Any test over `SMOKE` or the shard counts (`ci-scope.test.ts`, `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, a shard-specs test) is updated and green.
- This pull request's own `e2e smoke` shards each finish under about 5 minutes.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43984353895)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Part of this needs a person:** the issue's step 2 (lower `[e2e] smoke`) and step 5 (the `ci.yml` header) can't be finished by the bot. Neither blocks the rest.
- **Step 2:** `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` is under `bot/` and pins the live count. Lowering `smoke` to 3 would make the required `bot selftest` go red, and the bot can't fix that.
- **Step 5:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is under `.github/`.

This plan keeps `smoke = 4`, which still meets the issue's goal (see Goal). Exact lines for the person are under **Open questions**.

# Plan: #4092 — e2e smoke drops specs 46 and 47 to the daily run

## 1. Goal

Remove `"46"` and `"47"` from `SMOKE` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`, so a pull request's `e2e smoke` plays only 01, 06, 10, 13, 19 and 51. Both specs keep running in `super.yml`'s full split, in exactly one shard each. Update every doc and comment outside `.github/` that says 46 or 47 run per pull request, citing #4092. Per the owner's waiver, write no stand-in spec or test.

**Shard count stays 4.** The six remaining specs deal over 4 shards by `WEIGHTS` as `1: 19`, `2: 51`, `3: 01`, `4: 06, 10, 13`, with 99 s the heaviest. That is under every shard that took 3.5–4.5 min before. It also keeps `bot selftest` green and the PR self-merging.

## 2. Files to touch

| Path | Change |
|---|---|
| `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs` | `change`: the `SMOKE` constant and its doc comment (lines 20–27) |
| `scripts/ci-shards.toml` | `change`: comment only, the `[e2e]` block at lines 51–59. `smoke = 4` stays |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` | `change`: header comment, line 7 |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts` | `change`: header comment, line 8, and the `SIGNED_IN` doc comment, line 50 |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts` | `change`: the doc comment above `SIGNED_IN`, lines 20–24 |
| `e2e/README.md` | `change`: smoke list, lines 58–59 |
| `spec/rulings/R1581000.md` | `change`: **Proof.** paragraph, line 32 (prose only; `proven_in` stays) |
| `spec/rulings/R2122000.md` | `change`: **Proof.** paragraph, lines 36–37 (prose only) |
| `docs/v0.3.0/README.md` | `change`: §7 `e2e smoke` table row, line 155 |

**Must not touch:**
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` and `bot/` (so not `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`).
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` and `spec/pending/` (no new ruling is made).
- `WEIGHTS` and `COMPONENT_WEIGHTS` in `shard-specs.mjs`, which still weigh 46 and 47 for the full split.
- `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` and `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`. A grep found neither reads `SMOKE`, the shard counts or the smoke list, so nothing there needs updating.

## 3. Steps

1. **`e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`.** Replace the `SMOKE` doc comment and constant with:
   ```js
   /**
    * The per-pull-request smoke list (docs/v0.3.0/README.md §7), one spec per user-facing flow: 01 a
    * hotseat game and its replay hash, 06 a networked match, 10 the invite gate, 13 practice against the
    * AI, 19 the queue modes and a series, 51 the menus' shell (R3728000). Specs 46 (every menu on one
    * screen, R1581000) and 47 (every control's tap area under a finger, R2122000) run in the daily super
    * run only: issue #4092, an owner decision, cut them because each took a smoke shard to itself
    * (7.1-7.7 and 5.6-6.0 min) and set the slowest chain through CI. Spec number prefixes, as WEIGHTS keys them.
    */
   export const SMOKE = ["01", "06", "10", "13", "19", "51"];
   ```
   Change nothing else in the file. `smokeSpecs` and the CLI work from `SMOKE`.

2. **`scripts/ci-shards.toml`, `[e2e]` comment.** Rewrite lines 51–59 and leave `smoke = 4` as is. The new comment must say, in your own words:
   - The smoke specs are the six in `SMOKE`, dealt by `WEIGHTS`.
   - History: with 2 shards they ran 8m 7s and 8m 57s (#3764), and at 4 (#3765) specs 46 and 47 each sat alone in a shard, running 7.1–7.7 and 5.6–6.0 min. #4092 moved both to the daily run.
   - Today `shardSpecs` deals the six as `1: 19; 2: 51; 3: 01; 4: 06, 10, 13`, at most 99 s by `WEIGHTS`.
   - A count of 3 would deal `10, 19 / 06, 51 / 01, 13` and save one runner. It needs `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`'s pin of the live count (`[1, 2, 3, 4]`) changed, and the night bot may not edit that.
   - The count may not exceed the 6 `SMOKE` specs (a shard with none exits 1) or 8 (`matrix.py`'s `MAX_SHARDS`). Any other count also needs that pin changed.

   Delete the stale "refresh WEIGHTS from the first `e2e smoke (k/4)` timings" sentence and the "47 and 46 sit alone" sentence.

3. **`46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` line 7.** Replace `Per pull request: SMOKE in scripts/shard-specs.mjs holds 46.` with:
   `Daily only (issue #4092): a pull request's \`e2e smoke\` plays only SMOKE in scripts/shard-specs.mjs, which does not hold 46, since it took a smoke shard to itself (7 minutes); super.yml plays it.`
   Keep ` Networked: the signed-in menus` and the rest of the sentence. Re-wrap the comment lines to the file's width.

4. **`47-tap-areas.cy.ts`.**
   - Line 8: replace `Per pull request: SMOKE holds 47. Networked as 46.` with `Daily only (issue #4092): SMOKE in scripts/shard-specs.mjs does not hold 47, which took a smoke shard to itself (6 minutes); super.yml plays it. Networked as 46.`
   - Line 50: replace the sentence with `/** p2, not 46's p1: a shard that plays 46 and 47 on one server has both specs' menus in one minute, which passes R109's allowance for one account. */`

5. **`51-menu-shell.cy.ts` lines 20–24.** Make the comment true now that 46 and 47 are not in smoke:
   `46 signs in as p1 too, and the daily split can run it on 51's server; 47, which can run just before 51, signs in as p2. A 429 here means 51 shared a minute with another p1 spec: give it p2.`
   Keep the first sentence about R109's 300 requests a minute. Leave `SIGNED_IN = accounts.p1` untouched.

6. **`e2e/README.md` lines 58–59.** Make the sentence read: the smoke list (01, 06, 10, 13, 19, 51, `scripts/shard-specs.mjs`'s `SMOKE`) on every pull request, every spec in the daily super run. Then add: `Specs 46 and 47 run in the daily super run only (#4092): each took a smoke shard to itself, 7 and 6 minutes.` Leave the "Specs 46, 47 and 51 … `MENU_SIZES`" sentence at line 60.

7. **`spec/rulings/R1581000.md` line 32.** Replace `It runs on every pull request (\`e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs\`'s \`SMOKE\`).` with `It runs in the daily super run, not per pull request (issue #4092 took it out of \`e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs\`'s \`SMOKE\`: it took a smoke shard to itself, 7 minutes).`

8. **`spec/rulings/R2122000.md` lines 36–37.** Same change: `It runs on every pull\nrequest (…SMOKE)` becomes `It runs in the daily super run, not per pull request (issue #4092 took it out of …'s \`SMOKE\`: it took a smoke shard to itself, 6 minutes).`

9. **`docs/v0.3.0/README.md` line 155.** After `19 (queue modes and series)` add `and 51 (the menus' shell)`. After `against a release build of \`jackioh-server\`` add `; specs 46 and 47 run daily only (#4092)`. Keep `| < 5 min |`.

10. **Pull request body.** State that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 28–30 are stale and need a person (see **Open questions**).

## 4. Tests

No test file is added or changed. The existing tests don't read `SMOKE` or `smoke = 4` except `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`, which stays green because the count is unchanged. Run from the repository root:

- **Neither spec is in smoke, and no shard is empty.**
  ```
  (cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke $k 4; echo; done)
  ```
  Expect exactly these four lines (paths are `cypress/e2e/…`): `19-…`; `51-menu-shell`; `01-hotseat-full-game`; `06-room-code,10-invite-gate,13-practice-vs-ai`. Also run `(cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke $k 4; done) | grep -cE '/(46|47)-'` and expect 0.
- **The full split still places both in one shard each.**
  ```
  (cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs $k 8 | tr ',' '\n'; done | grep -cE '/(46|47)-')
  ```
  Expect 2. Repeat with the shard count 4 (`1 2 3 4`, `… 4`) and expect 2.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` (the two ruling notes changed prose only).
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p test_ci_matrix.py`
- `pnpm exec eslint e2e` (comment-only edits).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` (a regression run; the harness's changed-files web run also covers it).

## 5. Done when

- [ ] `SMOKE` is `["01", "06", "10", "13", "19", "51"]` and its comment cites #4092.
- [ ] No `--smoke k 4` shard lists 46 or 47, and none is empty.
- [ ] The full split (8 and 4 shards) lists 46 and 47 once each.
- [ ] `ci-shards.toml` comment is current, `smoke = 4` is unchanged, and `bot selftest`'s matrix test passes.
- [ ] The 46, 47 and 51 comments, `e2e/README.md`, `R1581000.md`, `R2122000.md` and `docs/v0.3.0/README.md` say 46 and 47 are daily only.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check` pass.
- [ ] The pull request body carries the stale `ci.yml` lines (below) and the count-3 follow-up.
- [ ] No file under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/` is in the diff.

## 6. Risks

- **A new count.** Editing `ci-shards.toml`'s count turns `bot selftest` red, so change only the comment there.
- **Ruling notes.** `spec check` ties each `proven_in` to a test. Don't touch front matter, test names or R-ids in `R1581000.md` or `R2122000.md`.
- **Weights.** 46's measured time (Cypress 6:22 for 210 tests) is well above its `WEIGHTS` entry of 180, and 47's measured time is also above its 200. That makes super.yml's shards 2 and 3 heavier than they look. Out of scope, so leave it alone; refresh `WEIGHTS` as a follow-up if the daily run drifts.
- **Self-check.** This PR's own `e2e smoke` shards should each finish under about 5 minutes. If one doesn't, report its name and time rather than raising any timeout.

## 7. Open questions

For a person, after merge or on the pull request:

1. **`.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 28 is stale.** Replace
   `#   e2e smoke  Chrome only, specs 01, 06, 10, 13, 19, 46 and 47 (e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs SMOKE)`
   with
   `#   e2e smoke  Chrome only, specs 01, 06, 10, 13, 19 and 51 (e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs SMOKE)`.
   Lines 29–30 ("four since #3764") stay true while `smoke = 4`.
2. **Optional: go to 3 shards** (deals `10, 19 / 06, 51 / 01, 13`, at most 131 s by `WEIGHTS`, one runner fewer). Set `smoke = 3` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml`. In `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` change three lines:
   - line 75: `[1, 2, 3, 4]` becomes `[1, 2, 3]`;
   - line 120: `"smoke = 4"` becomes `"smoke = 3"`;
   - line 134: `"[e2e]\nsmoke = 4"` becomes `"[e2e]\nsmoke = 3"`.

   I rejected doing this now because the bot can't edit `bot/`, so the required `bot selftest` would go red. I rejected 2 shards because it deals the same 169 s and 172 s loads as the old shards 3 and 4. Those ran 3.5–4.5 min, so there is no headroom under 5.
````
